scope: Independent safe-only calculation and pixel review
sequenceHashMethod: SHA256 of compact UTF8 JSON array of full href strings, no final newline
limitations: Only two Back branches were tested here: mobile default in-app Back and desktop latest browser Back. This is not a six-combination filtered Back pass.
Latest identity order matches across three widths. Default and latest have the same identity set but different order; no sequence-equality claim is made between those sorts.
Cross-width/sort identity checks normalize URL pathnames and ignore from-query formatting. Within each Back comparison the full stored href sequence matches exactly.
Proof record 8 is stale during nonmatching-query clearing and is excluded. Accepted record 9 restores the initial 20 with More available, not an automatically loaded 40.
Safe images show only query/type/count UI; the competition filter and full league-card labeling/identity counts come from stored DOM records.
Tablet source raster is 788×505 while CSS metadata reports 789×505. No resizing occurred.
No fresh browser replay, physical-device coverage, whole-page keyboard pass or independent serving-SHA observation.
scrollY was not measured; no exact scroll-position or focus restoration claim.
Source metadata collection hashes describe different appendable snapshots, not a frozen five-image set; exact snapshot timestamps were not recorded.
